definitions.explanation: A piece of ground used for growing plants.
The area of ground around a house.

examples.english: To plant flowers in the garden.
The tree in the garden has gotten big.
Watering the flowers in the garden every morning has become my daily routine.

notes:
{庭|にわ} refers to both cultivated gardens and general yard/outdoor space around a house.

USAGE:
Unlike English, {庭|にわ} covers both "garden" (planted area) and "yard" (general outdoor space). Context determines which meaning applies.

JAPANESE GARDENS:
- ⟦{日本庭園|にほんていえん}→日本庭園：19199_nihonteien⟧: Japanese-style garden
- ⟦{枯山水|かれさんすい}→枯山水：noentry⟧: dry landscape garden (rocks and gravel)
- ⟦{茶庭|ちゃにわ}→茶庭：noentry⟧: tea ceremony garden

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{庭師|にわし}→庭師：12491_niwashi⟧: gardener
- ⟦{中庭|なかにわ}→中庭：11308_nakaniwa⟧: courtyard, inner garden
- ⟦{庭先|にわさき}→庭先：noentry⟧: front of the garden/yard
- ⟦{裏庭|うらにわ}→裏庭：noentry⟧: backyard

- {庭|にわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to maintain the garden
